notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
- Added a notification when a line is validated
- Added of a visual aid to better identify the active side
- Added an animation on the score
- Added an animation when die is dropped
- Added an animation to highlight the bonuses
- Added an animation when a record is broken (the game must be completed to validate a record)
- Unlocking max FPS to 60 for better mouse fluidity
- Sound loop adjustment (I think)
- Changed the visual of the remaining bonus
- Fixed a bug that did not display the “resume” button when pausing
- Changed the point gauge
- The projection now disappears at level 3, instead of level 2
- Bricks are double from level 4 instead of 3
- Modification of timers from level 5 (15s, then -1 second per level until level 14)
- Added translations (on new texts)
